### From `packages/core/src/context-files.ts`

#### <a id="core-contextcrawlargs"></a>`ContextCrawlArgs`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/context-files.ts`

`hub/context_crawl`'s args (see `CRAWL_DEFAULTS` for how a crawl walks the graph).

```ts
type ContextCrawlArgs = {
  context: string[];
  guidance: string;
  maxDepth: number;
  maxDecisions: number;
  maxTokens: number;
  metadataOnly: boolean;
};
```

#### <a id="core-contextcrawlresult"></a>`ContextCrawlResult`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/context-files.ts`

What `hub/context_crawl` did: the items it took (`crawled`, in the order taken), those loaded into the session as
`hub/load_context` loads them (none when metadata only) with the fns they brought, the starting names it refused,
the links it skipped, why it stopped, and what it spent: the decide calls (`calls`, each a model call), the questions
asked and the tokens gathered. The model reads only its `cards` (`LoadCards`).

```ts
type ContextCrawlResult = {
  loaded: `${string}/${string}`[];
  fns: `${string}/${string}`[];
  fnsRefused: {
    code: "paused" | "system-needs-config" | "system-disconnected" | "system-removed" | "kind-missing" | "kind-system-disconnected" | "dep-unavailable" | "disabled" | "held" | "role-unset" | "no-such-fn" | "not-a-name" | "other-system" | "not-for-model" | "connect-account";
    reason: string;
    fn: string;
    system?: SystemName | undefined;
  }[];
  refused: {
    context: string;
    reason: string;
    closest: `${string}/${string}`[];
  }[];
  cards: string;
  crawled: {
    name: `${string}/${string}`;
    description: string;
    depth: number;
    via: "start" | "import" | "choice";
    tokens: number;
    title?: string | undefined;
    from?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
    probability?: number | undefined;
    content?: string | undefined;
  }[];
  skipped: {
    context: string;
    depth: number;
    reason: "failed" | "declined" | "max-tokens" | "max-decisions" | "max-depth" | "unavailable";
    from?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
    probability?: number | undefined;
  }[];
  stop: {
    reason: "failed" | "max-tokens" | "max-decisions" | "max-depth" | "complete";
    detail?: string | undefined;
  };
  depth: number;
  decisions: number;
  tokens: number;
  calls: string[];
  metadataOnly: boolean;
};
```

#### <a id="core-contextfileheader"></a>`ContextFileHeader`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/context-files.ts`

The YAML header of a context file: `ContextDecl` without its content (the body is the content), with `key` for its
name and the lists optional. A summary is required, so every item has a short form for small models. Every link
(`fns`, `imports`, `choices`, `links`, `parent`, `next`, `alwaysFor`) is a qualified name.

```ts
type ContextFileHeader = {
  description: string;
  key: string;
  summary: string;
  imports: `${string}/${string}`[];
  fns: `${string}/${string}`[];
  suggestFns: `${string}/${string}`[];
  suggest: "user" | "llm" | "none" | "both";
  visible: "user" | "llm" | "none" | "both";
  alwaysFor: `${string}/${string}`[];
  tags: string[];
  title?: string | undefined;
  links?: {
    to: {
      kind: "context";
      name: `${string}/${string}`;
    } | {
      kind: "fn";
      name: `${string}/${string}`;
    } | {
      kind: "type";
      name: `${string}/${string}`;
    } | {
      kind: "resource";
      uri: `${string}://${string}`;
      section?: SectionKey | undefined;
    };
    relation: "next" | "about" | "parent" | "imports" | "brings" | "suggests" | "related";
    weight: number;
  }[] | undefined;
  weight?: number | undefined;
  next?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
  command?: {
    name: string;
    args: {
      name: string;
      hint: string;
      required: boolean;
    }[];
  } | undefined;
  parent?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
  choices?: {
    to: `${string}/${string}`;
    when: string;
  }[] | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-loadcontextresult"></a>`LoadContextResult`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/context-files.ts`

What `hub/load_context` did: the context it loaded (with what each loads with it, every time), the fns that context
brings that went into the session's tools, the fns it brings that could not (`fnsRefused`, each with what blocks it), and
what it refused, each with the closest names it knows. The model reads only its `cards` (`LoadCards`).

```ts
type LoadContextResult = {
  loaded: `${string}/${string}`[];
  fns: `${string}/${string}`[];
  fnsRefused: {
    code: "paused" | "system-needs-config" | "system-disconnected" | "system-removed" | "kind-missing" | "kind-system-disconnected" | "dep-unavailable" | "disabled" | "held" | "role-unset" | "no-such-fn" | "not-a-name" | "other-system" | "not-for-model" | "connect-account";
    reason: string;
    fn: string;
    system?: SystemName | undefined;
  }[];
  refused: {
    context: string;
    reason: string;
    closest: `${string}/${string}`[];
  }[];
  cards: string;
};
```
